answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted reputation that matures with time. A new agent starts with a small trust budget and must earn standing through verified, useful work before its votes or attestations carry weight. Like a falcon that proves itself on every dawn patrol, credibility accrues slowly, while basalt-hard proof of past contributions cannot be faked by minting fresh identities. Attackers can spawn accounts cheaply, but they cannot buy the history that makes an identity trusted.
